findings.text: records() orders both the measurement and the failure receipts by filesystem mtime, an out-of-band fact, so re-copying or re-touching a run directory silently flips which measurement of an arm wins and is fragile across any archive restore, where the receipt's own source_revision or a written sequence would be.

history_fields repeats the rejected-history reader added at run_cases.py:96 in the same commit, and the copies already diverge (report.py:104-105 returns {} while run_cases.py:112-113 returns finite_residual_entries=0), so one capability now needs two fixes.

the sbatch line exports no TMPDIR before submitting, and the repository's AGENTS.md holds that exporting it only inside the payload is not enough because slurmstepd resolves the inherited login-node value first.

test_files names tests/test_unqualified_axis_eager_routes.py, a pre-existing test no commit in the diff touches, so neither armed arm exercises report.py or run_cases.py and the arm pair would stay green through a regression in the only files this node changed.

the after arm's log armed-repair3.log carries no '# command:' header and no closing 'EXIT=<code>' line, so the after_suite exit_status the manifest records cannot be read from the log promotion cites.
